mapper.sql: aga.approval_id as "approvalId", aga.grant_application_id as "grantApplicationId", aga.linked_achievement_id as "linkedAchievementId", aga.evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", aga.approval_status as "approvalStatus", aga.previous_status as "previousStatus", aga.next_status as "nextStatus", aga.requested_amount_snapshot as "requestedAmountSnapshot", aga.payment_amount_snapshot as "paymentAmountSnapshot", aga.account_snapshot_ref as "accountSnapshotRef", aga.reason_code as "reasonCode", aga.opinion as "opinion", aga.processed_by as "processedBy", aga.processed_at as "processedAt", aga.change_reason as "changeReason"

where.if: and cast(aga.grant_application_id as varchar) like concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedApplicantName}, '%')

mapper.select:
select from academic_grant_approvals aga
order by aga.processed_at desc, aga.approval_id desc limit #{criteria.safeSize} offset #{criteria.offset}
select from academic_grant_approvals aga where aga.grant_application_id = #{grantApplicationId} order by aga.processed_at desc, aga.approval_id desc limit 1

select count(*) from business_status_transitions where business_type = 'ACADEMIC_GRANT' and definition_version = 'CONFIRMED' and from_status_code = #{fromStatus} and to_status_code = #{toStatus} and executor_role_code = 'R09'
select count(*) from rejection_reasons where reason_code = #{reasonCode} and business_type = 'ACADEMIC_GRANT' and active_yn = 'Y'

insert into academic_grant_approvals (grant_application_id, linked_achievement_id, evaluation_year, approval_status, previous_status, next_status, requested_amount_snapshot, payment_amount_snapshot, account_snapshot_ref, reason_code, opinion, processed_by, changed_by, change_reason, created_by, updated_by) values (#{grantApplicationId}, #{linkedAchievementId}, #{evaluationYear}, #{approvalStatus}, #{previousStatus}, #{nextStatus}, #{requestedAmountSnapshot}, #{paymentAmountSnapshot}, #{accountSnapshotRef}, #{reasonCode}, #{opinion}, #{processedBy}, #{processedBy}, #{changeReason}, #{processedBy}, #{processedBy}) returning approval_id as "approvalId", grant_application_id as "grantApplicationId", linked_achievement_id as "linkedAchievementId", evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", approval_status as "approvalStatus", previous_status as "previousStatus", next_status as "nextStatus", requested_amount_snapshot as "requestedAmountSnapshot", payment_amount_snapshot as "paymentAmountSnapshot", account_snapshot_ref as "accountSnapshotRef", reason_code as "reasonCode", opinion as "opinion", processed_by as "processedBy", processed_at as "processedAt", change_reason as "changeReason"
